question: In the Li3PO4-coated NCM study, how much did the charge-transfer resistance rise over 50 cycles for the bare and the coated material, and what capacity did each retain after 100 cycles at 1C?

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (8,11) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT round(224.04-27.99,2) AS bare_rct_rise_ohm, round(144.75-14.88,2) AS lpo_rct_rise_ohm

For the LPO-coated NCM, Rct rose from 14.88[5] to 144.75[6] ohm over the same cycling, a smaller rise of 129.87[7] ohm. Cycled at 1C[8], the bare NCM retained 75.4%[9] of its initial discharge capacity after 100 cycles[10], while the LPO-coated NCM had a capacity retention of 88.4%[11].
